newsitem.title: UK: Halifax members approve conversion to stock company.
newsitem.headline: Halifax members approve conversion to stock company.

text.p: Members of Halifax Building Society, Britain's largest mortgage lender, voted to convert the company from mutual ownership to stock ownership, its chairman said Monday.
Halifax Chairman John Foulds said at a meeting of Halifax's members that the conversion had been approved through votes from the society's 8 million account holders.
Of those voting more than 97 percent voted in favour of the conversion to stock ownership, the company said.
The stock offering, expected to value the society at some 12 billion pounds ($19.5 billion), was expected to proceed in June.
About 1,000 of the Halifax's members actually attended the meeting but many expressed dismay that the society was losing its mutual status.
Foulds assured them that the conversion would be in the best interests of its customers.
